subject: science
topicName: Comparing the Properties of Ionic, Covalent, and Metallic Substances
description: A Grade 9 chemistry lesson comparing bonding types using melting point, hardness, conductivity, structure, and everyday examples.
learningObjectives: Compare properties of ionic, covalent, and metallic substances
Explain conductivity patterns using particle movement
Connect structure to melting point and brittleness
Use evidence to identify likely bonding type
prerequisites: Metallic bonding and sea of electrons
